description: Record durable, reusable knowledge (conventions, architecture, commands, risks, decisions) as PROPOSED memories for human review. Keep each ATOMIC (one fact) and CONCISE (1–3 sentences). Use supersedes with an id from search_memory to correct an outdated memory.

confidence.description: How sure you are, from 0 to 1 (default 0.6)

evidence.description: Where this was learned, e.g. a file, command output or PR

paths.description: Repo paths this memory applies to

supersedes.description: Id of an outdated memory (from search_memory) that this replaces

type.description: A memory type key from get_repo_context.memoryTypes (built-ins: project_rule, architecture, command, workflow, decision, failure, risk, dependency, testing, deployment, business_context); unknown keys map to the closest type

repo.description: This repo's git remote or owner/name, e.g. 'BenjaminBeguin/memmo'. Call list_repos if unsure.

name: propose_memories
title: Propose Memmo memories
